name: epistemic-projection
description: Belief is projected from the Assertions on record. Silence is insufficient and never rejection; repetition is not corroboration; material disagreement is contested rather than decided.

Option.description: A preference option used by these fixtures. A real Space types each option by its kind (Profile §5.5, §7), because prefers partitions by the option's Concept Type; one catch-all type is one partition.

cases.name: nothing on record is insufficient, not rejected
an unsupported Proposition has no support and no opposition
a projection declares that its score is not a probability
a projection reports the policy it ran under
BELIEF over an unbound variable is refused, not guessed
BELIEF SLOT over an unbound subject is refused
an unknown epistemic policy is named rather than defaulted
repetition is one voice: a side reports its roots, not its rows
two claims relaying one observation score as one
a fully grounded BELIEF about a Proposition nobody created still answers
explanation: none returns no ledger rather than an empty one
a setting WITH EPISTEMIC does not implement is refused, never ignored
BELIEF SLOT takes a subject an earlier pattern bound
a bound BELIEF SLOT stays joined to the row it came from
a BELIEF triple stays joined to the row its endpoints came from
a BELIEF triple with an open object answers one belief per Proposition
a BELIEF SLOT subject bound to a Literal answers insufficient, and keeps its row
